hooks.command:
bash -c '
INPUT=$(cat)
FILE_PATH=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty")

if [[ "$FILE_PATH" == */sdlc/output-styles/sdlc-marvin.md ]] || [[ "$FILE_PATH" == */sdlc/output-styles/sdlc-rules.md ]]; then
  jq -n "{
    hookSpecificOutput: {
      hookEventName: \"PreToolUse\",
      permissionDecision: \"deny\",
      permissionDecisionReason: \"❌ Do not edit generated output style files directly. Edit the templates instead:\n\n- For Marvin personality: sdlc/output-styles/.templates/personality-marvin.md\n- For rules header: sdlc/output-styles/.templates/personality-rules.md\n- For orchestration rules: sdlc/output-styles/.templates/orchestration-rules.md\n\nThe output styles are automatically regenerated when you edit templates.\"
    }
  }"
else
  echo "{}"
fi
'

bash -c '
INPUT=$(cat)
FILE_PATH=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty")

if [[ "$FILE_PATH" == */sdlc/output-styles/.templates/* ]]; then
  echo "🔄 Template edited, rebuilding output styles..." >&2
  cd "$(dirname "$FILE_PATH")/.."
  ./.build-output-styles.sh >&2
  echo "{}"
else
  echo "{}"
fi
'
